items.note: S2.1.1 says only that a fixed linear network exchanges two banks with signs and restores auxiliary values (the intro sentence at 120-122). It gives none of the content: h=100, triples, the copy/gather/scatter/side schedule, the cancellation, or (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).

S2.1.2 has the right idea: invertible frames make intermediate frames cancel, so a route applies only an endpoint operator. It omits the edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the fact that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, and the formula D_out S D_in^{-1} (or D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}). It also assigns frames only 'at each gate', where the paper assigns them at sources, gates and sinks.

S2.1.3 names nested subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from three-element subset intersections. It gives none of the budget: no nondegenerate labels, no single decreasing edge type losing h, no L=Ich, no Wm-2N+2L, and no L/N ratios.
S2.1.2 says only that the endpoint operator may be 'an address shear'. It does not give the projection matrices, the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, or s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.

The only allusion is S2's method: both procedures come from fixed linear networks with a strict rank saving. Nothing on phase frames C_U, translation kernels aI+bX_v, s_c, or C^{tensor m} on every role.
The plan states s<Wm and s/W<m as the source of the power saving, which is correct. It omits why (L<N/2, deficit N-2L), the deficits eta, and the explicit tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^tau.
These appear only as the 'stream-operations' dependency of S2.1. No step states a linear-cost digit move, a row split or a controlled shift.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones in Pi and the conclusion of a interchanges are right. The plan drops that E_1,E_2 are invertible, that there are O(V) further triangular updates, and that the arithmetic is over Z/q^b for a fixed prime q. The elimination proof and the three-update implementation of each pivot are not shown.

S2.1.6 states the O(Ve^tau) interchange of e=m^k chunks but omits that a preceding row field must be divisible by W^k. Its siblings follow the paper's route: cyclic split into W role streams, frames, s<Wm, s calls on volume V/W raising the normalized cost by s/W, and edges as a interchanges. Missing are the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D on every row and the three updates D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D that turn the shear into an interchange; the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) is given only in words.

S2.1 states the O(Vu^tau) interchange of two disjoint contiguous u-bit fields in a Cartesian-product array, as in Lemma lem:chunk-swap. The reduction to power-width pieces (row field, padding, base-m split) is not given.
No step mentions phase frames, binary changes of basis P_M, child calls on C^{tensor f}, or the H_0 = b S C S identity.
Nothing about packed selected-bit XORs, cyclic chunk shifts, or repair of the bad set.

S2's method says 'recurse', and S2.2 depends on recursive-saving, whose step S2.1.4 is phrased for the interchange. The plan has no F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), no leaves, and no row-index construction.

Cost O(Vd^{lambda'}), H_0 on the same bit of at most d chunks, and error < sqrt2 2^{-p} all match the proposition. It omits the parameter regime (d of order p^epsilon, K=floor(d^c), record length r), the exact Gaussian-dyadic evaluation and the single final truncation.
S3.1 correctly states character cancellation and F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I. S3.2 says 'at the stated cost' but gives no cost, no layout permutation L, no bit-reversed order B, and no error bound.

Signed packing with the established multiplier in time O(rp log(rp)) is right. 'Computed exactly' is loose: the lemma computes exact numerators but returns Q_p(fg/r) with error < sqrt2 2^{-p}. The packing base is not given.

The construction is right: two forward transforms kept in a common order, pointwise products, then the opposite transform. Missing are the normalization (f*g)/(rM), the final scale by M, the error bound and the cost.
S4.1 paraphrases the intro: contractions, with the permutations retained. There is no identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, no condition on theta, and no tensor form or cost.
Bluestein's identity turning QF_t into a convolution is named, without the chirp a or the formula. The cancellation of the source permutation R, eq:source-permutation-cancel, appears nowhere.
Only kappa=2^{-182} and the existence of p, d, r and 'fixed rational parameters' appear. Missing are p=6b, d=floor(b^epsilon), the other exponents and the choice of prime source lengths.
The Chinese-remainder map that preserves convolution is named, without Phi, the mu_i, or the triangular digit formula.
S6 describes the effect (negative wrap recovers the cyclic wrap after untwisting) but not the map x_d -> zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r}, or the resulting formula for M_C.

S7 lists the stages loosely (digits, address map, three transforms, scalings, rounding, carries). It has no source-transform composition, the scales by S and 2^{2b+4}S are absent, and nothing says why R cancels.

The key conclusion is right: error below 1/2 lets rounding and carry propagation give the exact product. The error chain (E_s, E_w, 448b 2^{-b+gamma}) and the roles of p=6b and gamma<=b/4 are missing.

The claim that every cost-table term is at most p^{1-2kappa}, giving total O(n (lg n)^{1-kappa}), matches 4983-4995. The table's terms, the margins with min g_2=2^{-181}, the absorption of log factors and the schoolbook cutoff are not given.
The n log n conjecture appears only as a dependency of S0. No step states that the bound refutes an eventual Omega(n log n) lower bound.

errors.says: E_1,E_2 are lower triangular and a shear of rank a needs only a interchanges in tape order.
errors.paper: E_1,E_2 are invertible lower triangular. The shear (H,D)->(H+AD,D) over Z/q^b uses exactly a interchanges plus O(V) further triangular work, for a fixed odd prime q.

errors.says: Two disjoint contiguous address chunks of e=m^k digits can be interchanged in O(Ve^tau) time.
errors.paper: This needs a row field preceding both chunks whose length is divisible by W^k, and q must be a prime as in Lemma lem:matrix-shear.

errors.says: Polynomial products in the ring are computed exactly by signed packing in time O(rp log(rp)).
errors.paper: The exact Gaussian-integer numerators of fg are computed, but the procedure returns Q_p(fg/r), with error < sqrt2 2^{-p}.

chain: The top-level tree follows the paper's order: radix reduction, CRT, resampling, chirp, twist, ring convolution, recovery, cost table. Only the address-interchange branch (S2.1) is decomposed into the paper's route: role split, frames, nested subspaces giving s<Wm, recursion by s/W<m, and edges as rank-many interchanges. Even there it skips the endpoint identity (shear H<-H+D on every role), the shear-to-interchange step and the explicit tau. The butterfly layer (S2.2) and every later step are single quoted claims with no mechanism: no phase frames, no layer recurrence, and no error or cost chain.

steps.note: S2.1.1 has a fixed network exchanging two banks with signs and restoring auxiliary values. It has no h=100, triples, N or m, and no (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).

S2.1.2 says the intermediate frames cancel. It lacks the mechanism (a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate), the formula D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the point that each edge costs only a change of frame.

S2.1.3 names nested subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from triple intersections. It gives no nondegeneracy, no tensor-cube label space, and no statement that only the central time-3-to-4 edges decrease, each by h.
S2.1.3 only says the subspaces 'give' a count s of smaller calls. That P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U, and that the source edges are rank-one exceptions, is not stated.
No step has sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, or s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
The plan asserts s<Wm. It gives neither the reason, L/N=100/539 or 101/539 below 1/2, nor the deficit N-2L>0.
S2.1.2 says the endpoint operator may be an address shear. It has no M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, and no statement that the same shear H<-H+D holds on every role.

S2.1.5 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, so a rank-a shear needs a interchanges. S2.1 turns each edge into smaller interchanges, and S2.1.4 says a node makes s calls. Missing are the O(V) further work and the invertibility of the E_i; conservatively this still counts, since the rank-to-calls mechanism is present.

S2.1.4 has s calls on volume V/W, with the normalized cost growing by s/W<m, giving O(Vu^tau). The explicit recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and the exponent tau=1-2^{-50} (from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20) are absent, so the step lacks its defining quantities.

central.summary: The plan carries the central saving only at the level of the paper's introduction (lines 118-179): a bank-exchanging network, cancelling frames, nested subspaces giving s<Wm, and recursion with factor s/W<m. Only the edge-to-recursive-call step (C8) is reconstructed with its defining content. The label budget Wm-2N+2L, the loss ratio L/N<1/2, the rank-equals-dimension-change fact, the endpoint identity I_m and the explicit exponent are missing, so the reader is told that s<Wm but not why.
